technical_and_design_decisions: Implement Teradata support using a dedicated Sqoop Teradata connection manager and JDBC driver integration, while preserving compatibility with existing Sqoop command-line arguments.
Make the logging directory configurable through an external Spring XD property, with the current ${xd.home}/logs location retained as the default.
Extract message-bus functionality into a reusable spring-bus Maven dependency and update Spring XD to consume the published or locally built artifact.
Extract serialization codec functionality into spring-bus alongside the message-bus code, preserving existing serialization formats and APIs where practical.
Extract input/output type conversion into spring-cloud-dataflow and expose extension points that allow custom modules to register or use custom domain-object converters.
Implement the singlenode XD Admin SPI using Module Launcher in the same JVM, with lifecycle isolation and an in-process communication mechanism appropriate for local pipeline execution.
Implement the Diego XD Admin SPI using the Receptor API and Module Launcher, including module lifecycle operations, status handling, and failure reporting.

Treat service-discovery self-registration as an investigation and prototype activity rather than a production implementation, evaluating module lifecycle, registration, health, deregistration, and compatibility constraints.
Use Maven dependency management and automated unit, integration, and regression tests to verify behavior after the repository and package extractions.
assumptions: The work is performed by one experienced Java/Spring developer familiar with Spring XD, Sqoop, Maven, Spring Integration, Cloud Foundry Diego, and the existing codebase.
An existing Spring XD source tree, build system, test framework, and CI environment are available and build successfully before the increment begins.
The required Teradata JDBC driver and any licensed Teradata test environment are available for development and integration testing.

Existing upstream spring-bus and spring-cloud-dataflow repositories or modules are available, or can be created within the organization's normal repository structure; this estimate includes integration work but not establishment of new project governance.
The extraction work preserves existing public behavior and does not require a broad redesign of the message bus, codecs, or conversion APIs.
The singlenode implementation targets local development and functional pipeline execution, not high availability or production-grade process isolation.
The Diego implementation targets the Receptor API version already used by the intended Cloud Foundry/Diego environment; changes required for multiple incompatible Receptor versions are excluded.
Service discovery infrastructure is available for evaluation, but U8 does not require delivery of a production-ready service-discovery implementation.
Documentation is limited to configuration, usage, migration, and developer integration documentation for the implemented changes.

Effort is expressed in workdays and includes development, code review preparation, automated testing, debugging, and local integration verification, but excludes elapsed waiting time and external approval delays.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing Spring XD module, admin SPI, logging, Sqoop, message-bus, codec, conversion, build, and test structures; identify affected interfaces and define migration boundaries and compatibility requirements.

Diagnose the direct Teradata JDBC failure, implement or integrate the Teradata connection manager, configure driver and dependency handling, support the specified import command, and add unit and integration coverage for Teradata imports and error cases.

Replace the hard-coded ${xd.home}/logs path with an externally configurable property, retain the existing default, update startup/configuration handling, and add tests and documentation for RPM-style paths such as /var/logs/spring-xd.

Move message-bus implementation and relevant tests into spring-bus, define the exported Maven API, resolve package and dependency changes, update Spring XD consumers, and verify backward-compatible runtime behavior.

activities.activity_name: Extract input/output type conversion into spring-cloud-dataflow
activities.activity_description: Move conversion interfaces, implementations, registration mechanisms, and tests into spring-cloud-dataflow; update module and runtime integration so custom modules can produce or consume custom domain objects.

Move codec interfaces and implementations into spring-bus, preserve supported serialization behavior, update Spring XD Maven dependencies and imports, and add compatibility and round-trip serialization tests.

Design and implement an in-process Admin SPI based on Module Launcher, including module creation, startup, shutdown, status monitoring, configuration propagation, error handling, and pipeline-level tests in a single JVM.

activities.activity_name: Implement Diego Receptor XD Admin SPI
activities.activity_description: Implement the Receptor-backed Admin SPI using Module Launcher, including application/module submission, lifecycle commands, environment and endpoint configuration, status polling, termination, failure handling, and mocked or available Diego integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Investigate module self-registration with service discovery
activities.activity_description: Analyze supported service-discovery mechanisms and module lifecycle constraints, produce an architecture recommendation, create a limited proof of concept for registration and deregistration if feasible, and document risks, required contracts, and next steps.

Run the complete build and test suite, validate extracted dependencies with Spring XD, exercise local and Diego admin paths, verify logging and Teradata configuration together with representative pipelines, and fix integration regressions.

Update configuration reference, migration notes, developer extension guidance, dependency and packaging metadata, sample commands, test setup instructions, and release notes for all delivered features.
